    AI Overview
    Cori Close
    is the head coach of the UCLA Women's Basketball team, a position she has held since April 2011. She is known as the Michael Price Family UCLA Women's Head Basketball Coach and has led the Bruins to over 300 career wins, including a 2025 Final Four appearance, making her one of the most successful coaches in school history. 
    Key Details About Cori Close: 
    • Tenure: Named head coach on April 21, 2011.
    • 2024-25 Season: Led the Bruins to their first NCAA Final Four, a No. 1 ranking, and was named the WBCA NCAA Division I Coach of the Year.
    • Coaching Philosophy: Emphasizes leadership, culture, and mentoring.
    • 2026 Context: As of March 2026, Close has expressed fatigue regarding the evolving challenges of modern college sports but remains the active leader of the team. 
    Current Coaching Staff (2025-26): 
    • Cori Close: Head Coach
    • Tony Newnan: Associate Head Coach
    • Tasha Brown: Assistant Coach
    • Soh Matsuura: Assistant Coach
    • James Clark: Assistant Coach
    • Michaela Onyenwere: Assistant Coach

    Close, who served on the Bruin coaching staff in 1994 and 1995, returned to Westwood after spending seven seasons as associate head coach at Florida State University.
